en.profileHelp: Sign-in needs a profile: terminal\profile.json (template: profile.example.json). It holds the GitHub user name and the log repo, never a password or token.
en.trustOff: This PC: ephemeral (sign-in data is wiped on exit)
en.trustOn: This PC: TRUSTED (sign-in is kept on this PC)
en.trustWarn: On a trusted PC the sign-in data is kept (on this PC, not on the stick) and the log says so. Only mark your own PC.
en.folderTitle: Which folder should Claude start in?
en.folderNoRecent: No Claude session has run on this PC yet.
en.folderGit: Find git repos in the usual places
en.folderWorkspace: Isolated workspace inside the kit (easy to delete)
en.worktreeAsk: Task name? It gets its own worktree: .claude\worktrees\<name>, branch wt/<name>. Leave empty to work in the folder itself.
en.worktreeSelf: Working in the folder itself; the worklines hook warns if someone else works here.
en.gateMissing: The phone gate (gate.ps1) is missing, so Claude does not start.
en.staleWiped: The previous session did not end cleanly; its sign-in data was wiped now
en.bannerWhat: At start an entry (a GitHub issue) is created in the private repo {0}, and the owner ({1}) is notified on their phone. It holds: time (UTC and local, time zone), computer name, Windows user, Windows edition and build, local IPv4 addresses, the kit path, the chosen folder, ephemeral or trusted PC, the kit version.
en.bannerPublicIp: The public IP address is included too; to get it the kit queries this service: {0}.
en.bannerBriefs: During the work, at most every {0} minutes and at the end, a short summary goes to the same place: repo, branch, worktree, the list of commits, the number of changed files. Typed text and file contents are NEVER included.
en.bannerDeny: The owner can deny access from their phone at any time: Claude then stops and the sign-in data is wiped.
en.bannerEnd: On exit the sign-in data is wiped (except on a trusted PC).
en.ghMissing: The GitHub CLI (gh) is missing. Install it from the Agent Workshop (4).
en.ghDevice: GitHub approval: on your PHONE open github.com/login/device and enter the code shown below. No browser opens on this PC.
en.ghWrongUser: A different GitHub account signed in ({0}), not the owner ({1}). Logging it out and stopping.
en.repoPublic: The log repo is PUBLIC. I do not log into a public repo; make it private or name another one.
en.repoMissing: The log repo ({0}) does not exist. Create it as private? (y/n)
en.issueFail: The log entry was not created, so Claude does not start.
en.waitAllow: Waiting for the owner's approval (an /allow comment on the entry)...
en.claudeLogin: If Claude asks you to sign in: open the URL it shows on your PHONE, sign in, and type the code back here.
en.running: Claude runs in the other window. This window watches for a deny (every {0} s). Ctrl+C: stop and wipe now. Closing this window also stops Claude.
en.denied: THE OWNER DENIED ACCESS. Claude was stopped and the sign-in data wiped.
en.keptTrusted: Trusted PC: the sign-in was kept.
en.recTitle: Suggestions (nothing is installed on its own)
en.foundTitle: Found on this PC, NOT installed by the kit (shown only; the kit never deletes these)
